scope: Independent textual review of FinalBridge.lean, ResearchTarget.lean and All.lean, before final aggregate build finished. No source edits made.
verdict: No mathematical or scope defect found in the reviewed statements/compositions. GlobalOptimality remains a definition; no inhabitant or unconditional global lower bound is supplied.
scope_notes: conditional_branch_lower_bound explicitly requires FirstChain, LeftBrace, RightBrace and both central support gaps, plus a shared first-octant unit direction.
support_model_attains_minimum is attainment for a two-function necessary-support model, not existence of a complete 37-square layout.

optimality_iff_two_missing_steps proves equivalence between unrestricted optimality and the conjunction of the missing global lower bound and exact endpoint feasibility. It does not prove either missing condition.

Feasible is the coordinate-based IsPacking predicate. SquareMetric proves isometry and injectivity of parameterization; an explicit equivalence of coefficient-open inside with Mathlib interior of closed is not yet proved. The coordinate definition is mathematically faithful; do not claim a formal equivalence to T154 PlainPacking has already been built.

global_grid_baseline.status: Mathematical implementation proposal, not yet formalized or executed as a search
global_grid_baseline.capacity_argument: Every square contains its open radius-1/2 disk. Two centers in a cell of diameter less than 1 have overlapping such disks, so cannot have disjoint square interiors. Closed cells are allowed; selecting any containing cell yields injectivity.
global_grid_baseline.count_caveat: Counts at m other than 64 do not assert the existence of capacity-one covers with that many cells.

executable_next_steps: Prove the square midpoint/inscribed-disk lemma with coefficient coordinates, then instantiate the exact 8x8 cover and capacity-one injection as a reusable global-to-finite theorem.

Construct improved rational polygon cells using wall containment for boundary cells and diameter certificates for interior cells. Independently check pointwise center coverage; a plot or area sum alone is insufficient.

Use certified partial-occupancy branch trees or constraint propagation, not the impossible full list of all 64-choose-37 rows. Each split must cover the parent, preserve owner count, and record a semantic implication.

Maintain each square angle in a complete independent domain, e.g. normalized theta in [-pi/4,pi/4] or half-angle q in [-(sqrt(2)-1),sqrt(2)-1]. Only a common D4 action may reflect the whole packing; independent positive-angle assumptions would lose configurations.
For each terminal state prove emptiness or capture into a specific proved local support class. Keep every residual unclosed state as an explicit remaining obligation.
Implement small feasible-packing and legal-boundary-contact positive controls, reject missing owners and incomplete angle coverage, and audit the final theorem statement and axiom list.
